author: Pxx500
name: GitHubTickets
install_msg:
GitHubTickets installed
Load it with `[p]load NHCogs.githubtickets`
short: Create pull request review tickets and route reviewers
description: Publish pull request tickets, manage developer expertise profiles, and route review requests through Discord
end_user_data_statement: GitHubTickets stores Discord guild and user IDs, optional GitHub user IDs and logins, categories, pull request repository IDs, pull request IDs and numbers, URLs, titles, authors, labels, draft and open state, update timestamps, Discord ticket locations, reviewer routing state, exclusions, ping history, and deadlines in SQLite. It stores GitHub delivery GUIDs and related event metadata for deduplication and recovery. Raw webhook request bodies are retained only while a delivery is pending or failed, then cleared after successful or terminal processing. Delivery identity and minimal result metadata are retained for at least seven days. GitHub add-assignee and remove-assignee outbox intents store ticket and transition IDs, repository and pull request identity, normalized GitHub login, state, retry counters, error summaries, and timestamps until their work is completed or cleaned up. Finished tickets, deleted ticket messages or threads, guild removal, and Red user-data deletion remove the corresponding data. Discord message content is not read back into the database.
